This violates the security policy which states that only the owner of the requested record may receive it.

def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    matrix = {("member", True): True, ("member", False): False}
    allowed = matrix.get((actor["role"], row["owner_id"] == actor["id"]), False)
    return row if allowed or actor["role"] == "member" else None
